div.div:
Blue: presentation Purple: our native C++ Green: installed Jade Amber: publish confirmation
Structural loads reconnect; old cursors expire. Scratch Pad / debugging hand off automatically; other tools reopen lazily.
Dashed arrows: file/snapshot inputs. Working is a database boundary, not an operating-system sandbox. Jade IDE is not required.
